claim.supported_scope: One continuous latent predictor by one observed continuous exogenous moderator interaction in a single-group recursive reflective ML SEM, estimated from the raw-data likelihood by LMS, with simple slopes and cbsem_bootstrap_v2 intervals.
claim.estimand: The unstandardized LMS interaction coefficient beta_xw and simple slopes beta_x plus beta_xw times w at the persisted centered moderator values.
assumptions: The accepted cbsem_ml_v1 base model is identified, converged, admissible, and contains reflective continuous predictor and outcome constructs.
The moderator is finite, nonconstant, observed, continuous, exogenous, mean-centered from the same complete cases, and not reused as an indicator.

The workflow independently qualifies reuse of cbsem_bootstrap_v2 case-resampling, seed, quantile, and failure rules while refitting LMS, and the frozen LMS likelihood, integration, convergence, and model-comparison settings are available.
exclusions: Latent-by-latent, categorical, endogenous, multiple, quadratic, three-way, multigroup, ordinal, robust, and multilevel interactions are excluded.
Factor-score OLS and product-indicator substitutions are not this LMS method.
Simple-slope extrapolation beyond the observed moderator range and causal claims are excluded.
warnings: The interaction coefficient is scale-dependent and sensitive to distributional and functional-form assumptions.
Conventional global chi-square fit from the no-interaction normal model must not be silently reused as LMS interaction-model fit.

equations.expression: eta = alpha + beta_x xi + beta_w W_c + beta_xw (xi W_c) + zeta

references.citation: Klein and Moosbrugger (2000), Maximum Likelihood Estimation of Latent Interaction Effects with the LMS Method, DOI 10.1007/BF02296338
Independent Python raw-data LMS likelihood, simple-slope, and bootstrap reference

simulations.design: One latent-by-observed interaction across zero, small, and large interaction effects, moderator distributions, sample sizes, loading strengths, predictor-moderator association, and main effects.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen independent data-generation, likelihood integration, and bootstrap streams indexed by scenario and replicate.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Bias, coverage, convergence, and null rejection must meet preregistered Monte Carlo limits and agree with the independent reference within tolerance.

simulations.design: Constant/non-finite/endogenous moderators, reused indicators, latent-by-latent requests, likelihood nonconvergence, and out-of-range slope requests.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen deterministic adversarial fixtures plus bootstrap streams where applicable.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every unsupported request or failed fit must be blocked/reason-coded exactly and must emit no misleading interaction result.

boundaries.case: The moderator is constant/non-finite or the LMS fit is nonconverged, non-finite, unidentified, or inadmissible.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The analysis fails explicitly and emits no interaction inference.

boundaries.case: The request is latent-by-latent, categorical, endogenous, multiple, multigroup, ordinal, robust, or reuses the moderator as an indicator.
The observed moderator is shifted or multiplied by a positive constant with the persisted centering/scale mapping applied.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped fitted values and likelihood are invariant while coefficients transform by the documented algebra within tolerance.

boundaries.case: The same data, model, integration settings, bootstrap settings, and seed run with different worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Likelihood solution, resamples, failures, intervals, and simple slopes are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: Centering, scale, integration setting, interaction identity, coefficient, slope, replicate, interval, or method identity is changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose identity differs from CB-SEM moderator v1.
Reject interaction output relabeled as another estimator or version.
Reject a base fit, moderator transformation, or resample whose data fingerprint differs.
Reject an archive entry whose recipe, likelihood, bootstrap, or result checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, non-finite coefficients, invalid centering, inconsistent slopes, or impossible bootstrap counts.
Never reinterpret PLS moderation, factor-score regression, or product-indicator output as LMS v1 evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: Any historical interaction-like result retains its estimator identity and cannot satisfy this LMS contract.

result_surfaces: Simple slopes and supported moderator range
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must produce identical centered inputs, likelihood settings, LMS estimates, resamples, failures, and simple slopes for the same recipe and seed.
accessibility_rules: Interaction and simple-slope visuals have equivalent accessible tables.
Observed range, uncertainty, failures, and warnings are communicated without color alone.
